title: A Signal for the Terminal
author: Ada Dunmore
blurb: Emrys Kavanagh, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
